# INTERVAL arithmetic

# Whether BigQuery subtracts TIME values, which its operators reference does not list but
# GoogleSQL does.

SELECT TIME '10:20:30.456789' - TIME '01:02:03.987654'
?>

# Whether - subtracts the months, then the days, in turn, as + adds them, so that the first step
# fails although the result is in range, and BigQuery's message.

SELECT DATETIME '0001-01-15 00:00:00' - INTERVAL '0-1 -30 0:0:0' YEAR TO SECOND
?>
